$comment: This repository has no published URL yet, so a config's $schema is the repository-relative path schemas/v2/config.json; the loader checks that suffix and never dereferences it. Give this file an absolute $id when the repository has a public home.
title: Health-GPS configuration, version 2
description: The published contract for a config v2 document. The loader in src/config is the authority — this file is documentation for humans and for editors, and is not consulted at runtime (docs/decisions/0022-hand-written-config-validation.md). tests/config/schema_agreement_test.cpp asserts that the loader rejects a document missing each property listed as required here, and rejects an unknown property at each level that sets additionalProperties: false, so the two cannot drift apart silently.

$schema.description: Should point at this file. A different value is a warning, because the loader has already validated the document; it usually means an upstream v1 config that tools/convert-config has not yet been run on.

version.description: The config format version. Kept from v1 so a hand-written config states its intent.

project_requirements.description: REQUIRED in v2, unlike upstream, where it is optional and absent from every primary example config while most current behaviour is gated on it (audit finding D-03).

population_impact_fraction.description: Reserved. Accepted by the schema so a PIF config keeps its shape, but rejected at load with feature_not_implemented when enabled is true; PIF is out of scope for this build (docs/decisions/0021-scope-finch-and-hlm-france.md).

$comment: Removed from v1 and rejected by name with their replacement: trend_type (use project_requirements.trend), income_categories (use project_requirements.income.categories), running.sync_timeout_ms (scenarios run sequentially, so there is nothing to time out).
